meta.title: Marcos Frigerio | Fullstack Developer
meta.description: Marcos Frigerio's portfolio: fullstack developer experienced in React, TypeScript and Node.js, with 10 prior years in industrial automation.
meta.ogDescription: Experience, skills and projects of Marcos Frigerio: fullstack development and industrial automation.

hero.lead: Electronic engineer with 10 years in industrial automation. Today I build software with React, TypeScript and Node.js for clients in the US and Europe.

freelanceUS.intro: As a fullstack developer I have taken part in:
bullets: Building new features using React, TypeScript, Neo4j and MariaDB as the main technologies.
Implementing improvements on an existing website.
Migrating the database from Neo4j to MySQL.
Creating scripts to verify and fix the databases.
Identifying and solving software problems, providing support to the client.
Deploying new versions of the website using AWS.
Migrating the UI to Storybook to build reusable generic components.

intive.location: Projects for clients in the US
intive.intro: I took part in several projects following Scrum, focused on authentication, streaming and blockchain:
bullets: Open the gate. Created and modeled objects for a streaming platform using C#, .NET and the MVC pattern.

Let them In. Took part in migrating an authentication process from Auth0 to a new one based on Firebase, using JavaScript as the main technology. Implemented integration tests using Cypress and GitHub Actions. Created a script to read and write in bulk on Firebase. We used Segment to store logs and analyze data.
BitGo. Implemented new features related to crypto assets such as Solana, Near, Avalanche and Algorand, using TypeScript and JavaScript.
MAAT. Developed features in TypeScript and NestJS to audit data using Blockchain technology.

freelanceEU.intro: I took part in building a Proof of Concept for a website forum. We used TypeScript, Auth0 and SQLite as the main technologies.

renault.intro: As an automation engineer, I was part of the projects office at Renault Team America, where I carried out the following activities:
bullets: Analyzed the existing facilities.
Prepared technical documentation for the modernization of the paint and assembly plants.
Supervised suppliers to make sure the Renault standard was implemented correctly.
Organized and took part in meetings to define solutions that benefit the interests of production, maintenance, safety and engineering areas.
Provided technical support to production and maintenance once the new facilities were completed.

automation.role: Automation Specialist - SAMI, AUSI, COMAU, VMC Refrigeración, Freelance
bullets: Programmed PLCs and HMIs on production lines and robotic cells for the automotive, refrigeration and Oil & Gas industries.
Took part in commissioning production lines at Ford, Fiat, General Motors and PSA Brazil.
Configured nodes, safety devices, variable speed drives, valve blocks, sensors and actuators.
Did structured cabling.
Selected instruments for explosive atmospheres in Oil & Gas projects.
Drew electrical diagrams and technical documentation using AutoCAD.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I was born in the province of Salta (Argentina), studied Electronic Engineering at the National University of Córdoba and live in Rafaela.
about.p2: Since 2021 I build software for clients in the US and Europe, focused on React, TypeScript and Node.js, as well as authentication, streaming and blockchain. Before that I worked for 10 years as an automation specialist programming PLCs and HMIs.
about.p3: I keep learning constantly: my latest courses include Claude Code, Docker, React and NestJS.
